```{r generate-gallery, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
# Auto-generate gallery from _pkgdown.yml — single source of truth.
# To add an article to this page, just add it to _pkgdown.yml articles sections
# and create a card SVG at man/figures/card-<slug>.svg.

# Find package root (works in pkgdown, devtools, and standalone rendering)
pkg_root <- tryCatch(
  rprojroot::find_package_root_file(),
  error = function(e) normalizePath(file.path(getwd(), "..", ".."))
)

pkg_yml <- yaml::yaml.load_file(file.path(pkg_root, "_pkgdown.yml"))

# Section metadata: CSS class and description for each section title
section_meta <- list(
  "Learn" = list(
    css = "fdars-learn",
    desc = "Get started, preprocess, and simulate functional data."
  ),
  "Represent" = list(
    css = "fdars-represent",
    desc = "Decompose, transform, rank, and measure functional data."
  ),
  "Align" = list(
    css = "fdars-align",
    desc = "Register and align curves to remove phase variability."
  ),
  "Regression" = list(
    css = "fdars-regression",
    desc = "Regression, classification, and mixed models for functional data."
  ),
  "Process Monitoring" = list(
    css = "fdars-analyze",
    desc = "Statistical process control for functional data streams."
  ),
  "Analyze" = list(
    css = "fdars-analyze",
    desc = "Infer, cluster, detect outliers, and test functional data."
  )
)

skip_sections <- c("Navigation", "Examples")

slug_from_entry <- function(entry) sub("^articles/", "", entry)

find_rmd <- function(slug) {
  candidates <- c(
    file.path(pkg_root, "vignettes", "articles", paste0(slug, ".Rmd")),
    file.path(pkg_root, "vignettes", paste0(slug, ".Rmd"))
  )
  found <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)]
  if (length(found)) found[1] else NA_character_
}

rmd_title <- function(path) {
  if (is.na(path)) return(NULL)
  lines <- readLines(path, n = 20, warn = FALSE)
  delims <- which(lines == "---")
  if (length(delims) < 2) return(NULL)
  yml <- yaml::yaml.load(paste(lines[(delims[1] + 1):(delims[2] - 1)],
                                collapse = "\n"))
  yml$title
}

find_card <- function(slug) {
  card_name <- paste0("card-", slug, ".svg")
  if (file.exists(file.path(pkg_root, "man", "figures", card_name))) {
    card_name
  } else {
    NULL
  }
}

html <- character()

for (section in pkg_yml$articles) {
  title <- section$title
  if (title %in% skip_sections) next
  meta <- section_meta[[title]]
  if (is.null(meta)) next

  html <- c(html, sprintf(
    '<h2 class="fdars-section-heading %s">%s</h2>', meta$css, title
  ))
  html <- c(html, sprintf(
    '<p class="fdars-section-desc">%s</p>', meta$desc
  ))
  html <- c(html, '<div class="fdars-gallery">')

  for (entry in section$contents) {
    slug <- slug_from_entry(entry)
    rmd_path <- find_rmd(slug)
    art_title <- rmd_title(rmd_path)
    if (is.null(art_title)) art_title <- tools::toTitleCase(gsub("-", " ", slug))
    card_file <- find_card(slug)
    href <- paste0(slug, ".html")

    if (is.null(card_file)) {
      html <- c(html, sprintf(
        '<a class="fdars-gallery-item" href="%s"><div class="fdars-gallery-thumb"></div><div class="fdars-gallery-title">%s</div></a>',
        href, art_title
      ))
    } else {
      html <- c(html, sprintf(
        '<a class="fdars-gallery-item" href="%s"><div class="fdars-gallery-thumb"><img src="../reference/figures/%s" alt="%s"></div><div class="fdars-gallery-title">%s</div></a>',
        href, card_file, art_title, art_title
      ))
    }
  }

  html <- c(html, '</div>')
}

cat(paste(html, collapse = "\n"))
```
